decision: Approve the two AmbientBackground naming conventions effect-profile (profile) and layer-opacity (opacity) as written.

evidence.userConfirmation: no dejes pendientes. todo de una cuando definamos specs. añade captura y acepta props
evidence.proposal: AmbientBackground contract v0.3 (issue #45) proposed effect-profile and layer-opacity; the owner accepted them.

limits: This is an assistant-recorded human decision, not provider-native, signed or independent review authority.
Approval binds names and semantic convention content, not component implementation.
No usage is recorded yet: AmbientBackground has no source; usages are added with reviewed source evidence at implementation.
Isotipo3D proposals (effect-scene, effect-progress, pointer-tilt) are not covered.

convention.name: profile
convention.meaning: A named preset of engine parameters for a decorative effect layer.
convention.whenToUse: Select among the effect presets supported by the component, such as density and speed profiles.
convention.avoid: Do not use it for visual Material treatment, sizes or arbitrary per-parameter overrides; preset names and values are component-specific.

convention.name: opacity
convention.meaning: The opacity of a decorative effect layer, a number from 0 to 1.
convention.whenToUse: Let the consumer fade a decorative layer in or out; a component may stop its work at 0.
convention.avoid: Do not use it as a general appearance override for interactive components or text; clamping and non-finite handling are component-specific.
